# project

Project roots and non-blocking file lists (harness-files.el).

- **Runs in:** the harness process
- **Source:** [lisp/modules/harness-project.el](../../lisp/modules/harness-project.el)
- **Loaded:** by default
- **Requires:** nothing
- **Required by:** [config](config.md), [session](session.md), [tasks](tasks.md), [worktree](worktree.md)

## About

Sessions are scoped to a project.  Roots and file lists come from
harness-files.el, shared with the UI so both agree on what a project
is; see there for why listing never blocks.

## Provides

### Methods

- `project/files` (root &optional query limit) — Return a promise of the files under project ROOT, relative to it.
- `project/invalidate` (root) — Forget projectile's cached file list for ROOT.
- `project/mains` (roots) — Return the main checkout of each of ROOTS, as (:root ROOT :main MAIN) entries.
- `project/name` (root) — Return a display name for the project at ROOT.
- `project/root` (cwd) — Return the project root directory for CWD, or CWD itself.
